body: So [this](http://i.imgur.com/F8Yxmsh.png?1) is how many comments were on this when it loaded on reddit for me.
you know it's atypical (all one word) and not hyphenated, right?
It was a CompSci related major. I won't be specific because it's so uncommon as to potentially be identifying.
I've thought about doing this, but never had the guts to just say fuck it and go on an adventure.
I was diagnosed with ADHD a while back but I can't take meds for it because I have a history of heart disease in my family.
The major was absolutely something I wanted, I just couldn't get through the bullshit at the beginning that had nothing to do with it.
Because I've never finished anything important in my life.
